title: pulsatilla halleri subsp. polyscapa
intro: Pulsatilla halleri subsp. polyscapa, commonly known as the Tibetan pasque flower, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Ranunculaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Pulsatilla halleri subsp. polyscapa include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
